dedupe_keys.name: hourly future climate scenarios for ten japanese weather stations

description: This deposit contains hourly future weather scenarios for ten Japanese stations, produced for impact assessments that require simultaneous meteorological conditions. The researchers combine 2017–2019 hourly observations with bias-corrected daily projections from four climate models under RCP2.6 and RCP8.5. The article describes 48 scenario variants spanning 2020–2080 for temperature, solar radiation, humidity, rainfall and wind speed. Mendeley lists sixteen ZIP containers and provides free access under CC BY-NC 3.0; commercial reuse is restricted. The metadata do not identify the file formats within the archives. Coverage is station-based, not a continuous national grid. Reusing historical subdaily patterns also limits the representation of future changes in short-duration extremes. A reviewer-assessed use is testing weather-sensitive building loads or infrastructure adaptation assumptions. model-energyplus is a related building simulator, but no weather-file conversion or direct import was checked. No archive or observation series was downloaded.
